teacher: IDSSE-only Set Transformer seed chosen from own validation, frozen
features: 64D frozen TCN embeddings; original alive head preserved
head: 64-to64 ReLU, conditional team residual, four positive L/R offsets, two detached-IoU quality scores
regression_weight: inverse native spell duration capped at10; each native H/A spell ends at D or team change; never event-only snippets
localization_loss: IoU or DIoU plus0.25 smoothL1(log1p offsets); localization quality target is detached predicted IoU, not centerness
calibration: one-dimensional ridge Platt on own calibration proposals with native IoU>=0.5; no test fitting
decoding: whole-possession proposal arcs plus unchanged HMM frame fallback; no proposal absence converted to D; zero bonus exactly equals reheaded HMM; same10Hz inputs/output grid as original HMM
selection: own validation robust spellF1, missing-case floor-0.02 and long-recall floor-0.03; unchanged teacher also eligible; freeze both pilot decisions before any probe test
limitations: local frozen embeddings, no additional temporal receptive field or feature pyramid; anchorless native spells cannot be learned with positive L/R anchor regression; not full TriDet
